AIROLI.name: Airoli Railway Station
AIROLI.police: Airoli Station does not house a standalone GRP/RPF station inside terminal premises. Outpost desks are near West Concourse Booking Office (Platform 1). Major grievances fall under Rabale Police Station along Thane-Belapur Road[cite: 1].
AIROLI.policeHi: Airoli Station ke andar standalone GRP/RPF thana nahi hai. Outpost desk West Concourse Booking Office (Platform 1) ke paas hai. Shikayatein Thane-Belapur Road sthit Rabale Police Station jati hain.
AIROLI.medical: West Exit (Sector 3): Jayshree Medical Store (Shop No. 5 right by station) & Sai Genericos[cite: 1]. Sector 3 market road also has Zeelab Pharmacy and Shree Samarth Krupa Medical[cite: 1].
AIROLI.medicalHi: West Exit (Sector 3): Jayshree Medical Store aur Sai Genericos. Sector 3 market road par Zeelab Pharmacy aur Shree Samarth Krupa Medical bhi hai.

Platform 1 (Southbound - Vashi/Panvel).title: Changing to Platform 2
steps: Walk towards wide pedestrian subways located closer to center and ends of Platform 1[cite: 1].
Walk down ramp/stairs and pass under tracks[cite: 1].
Take opposite stairs up to reach Platform 2[cite: 1].
stepsHi: Platform 1 ke center aur ends ke paas bane wide pedestrian subways ki taraf chalein.
Ramp ya stairs se niche utrein aur tracks ke niche se gujrein.
Platform 2 par pahunchne ke liye samne wali stairs up lein.

Platform 1 (Southbound - Vashi/Panvel).title: Ticket Counters & ATVMs
steps: West Side (Main Entry): Walk along Platform 1 toward central main concourse exit[cite: 1].
Find primary UTS Booking Office and ATVMs right inside main concourse hall[cite: 1].
East Side counter is often non-functional off-peak; stick to West Side[cite: 1].
stepsHi: West Side (Main Entry): Platform 1 ke sath central main concourse exit ki taraf chalein.
Main concourse hall ke andar primary UTS Booking Office aur ATVMs milenge.
East Side counter aksar off-peak band rehta hai; West Side hi use karein.

Platform 1 (Southbound - Vashi/Panvel).title: Main Station Exit & Auto Stand
Platform 1 (Southbound - Vashi/Panvel).titleHi: Main Station Exit aur Auto Stand
steps: Walk directly off Platform 1 into main concourse for West Exit facing Sector 3[cite: 1].
Primary Auto-Rickshaw Stand is right at entrance (regular meters and share-autos)[cite: 1].
East Exit FOB leads onto Thane-Belapur Road facing Mindspace IT Park[cite: 1].
stepsHi: Sector 3 face karte hue West Exit ke liye seedhe Platform 1 se main concourse mein aayein.
Entrance par hi primary Auto-Rickshaw Stand hai (regular meters aur share autos).
East Exit FOB Thane-Belapur Road par Mindspace IT Park ki taraf nikalta hai.

Platform 2 (Northbound - Thane).title: Changing to Platform 1
steps: Look for underground commuter subways near center and ends of platform[cite: 1].
Walk down ramp, walk through tunnel under tracks, and take stairs up directly onto Platform 1[cite: 1].
stepsHi: Platform ke center aur ends ke paas underground commuter subways dekhein.
Ramp se niche utrein, tunnel se tracks cross karein, aur seedhe Platform 1 ki stairs up lein.

KOPARKHAIRANE.name: Koparkhairane Railway Station
KOPARKHAIRANE.police: Security desk next to Platform 1 main booking window[cite: 1]. Formal complaints handled at Koparkhairane Police Station (Sector 4/6)[cite: 1].
KOPARKHAIRANE.policeHi: Platform 1 main booking window ke paas security desk hai. Formal complaints Koparkhairane Police Station (Sector 4/6) mein hoti hain.
KOPARKHAIRANE.medical: West Exit: Kalyani Medical Store and Laxmi Medical[cite: 1]. East Exit: Reliance Hospital is directly outside entrance area[cite: 1].
KOPARKHAIRANE.medicalHi: West Exit: Kalyani Medical Store aur Laxmi Medical. East Exit: Entrance area ke bilkul bahar Reliance Hospital hai.

Platform 1 (Southbound - Vashi/Panvel).title: Ticket Counters & West Exit
steps: Primary UTS Booking Office and ATVMs are inside West-side ground concourse hall (Sector 8A)[cite: 1].
Major Auto Stand is right outside gates[cite: 1].
stepsHi: Primary UTS Booking Office aur ATVMs West-side ground concourse hall (Sector 8A) ke andar hain.
Gates ke bilkul bahar major Auto Stand hai.

GHANSOLI.name: Ghansoli Railway Station
GHANSOLI.police: Police assistance desk adjacent to Platform 1 main booking window[cite: 1]. Ghansoli Police Outpost / Rabale jurisdiction[cite: 1].
GHANSOLI.policeHi: Platform 1 main booking window ke paas police assistance desk hai. Ghansoli Police Outpost / Rabale jurisdiction.
GHANSOLI.medical: West Exit: Ghansoli Medical & General Store and Asha Medical (2-min walk down station road)[cite: 1].
GHANSOLI.medicalHi: West Exit: Ghansoli Medical & General Store aur Asha Medical (station road par 2 minute ki duri par).

Platform 1 (Southbound).title: Exiting to Residential Node & Auto Stand
Platform 1 (Southbound).titleHi: Residential Node aur Auto Stand Exit
steps: Walk straight off platform into main concourse for Sectors 1-15[cite: 1].
Massive Auto Stand right outside West gate[cite: 1].
stepsHi: Sectors 1-15 ke liye platform se seedhe main concourse mein chalein.
West gate ke bilkul bahar bada Auto Stand hai.

TURBHE.name: Turbhe Junction Railway Station
TURBHE.police: Dedicated GRP/RPF police booth near Platform 1 Main Booking Concourse[cite: 1].
TURBHE.policeHi: Platform 1 Main Booking Concourse ke paas dedicated GRP/RPF police booth hai.
TURBHE.medical: West Exit: Janata Medical Store and Balaji Medical right outside toward Turbhe Market[cite: 1].
TURBHE.medicalHi: West Exit: Turbhe Market ki taraf bilkul bahar Janata Medical Store aur Balaji Medical hai.

Platform 1 & 3 (Vashi/Panvel Bound).title: Exiting to APMC Market & Turbhe Naka
Platform 1 & 3 (Vashi/Panvel Bound).titleHi: APMC Market aur Turbhe Naka Exit
steps: Head West off Platform 1 into main concourse toward APMC Grain Market[cite: 1].
Walk 3 minutes out to Turbhe Naka Bus Stop[cite: 1].
stepsHi: APMC Grain Market ki taraf Platform 1 se West main concourse mein jayein.
Turbhe Naka Bus Stop ke liye 3 minute chalein.

RABALE.name: Rabale Railway Station
RABALE.police: Security help desk near Platform 1 Station Master room[cite: 1]. Rabale MIDC Police Station nearby[cite: 1].
RABALE.policeHi: Platform 1 Station Master room ke paas security help desk hai. Paas mein hi Rabale MIDC Police Station hai.
RABALE.medical: West Exit: Radhe Flavia Medical in Sector 29 market street[cite: 1].
RABALE.medicalHi: West Exit: Sector 29 market street mein Radhe Flavia Medical hai.

Platform 1 (West Side - Residential).title: Exiting to Sector 29 Gothivali
steps: Walk off Platform 1 into ground booking hall. Exit into Sector 29 with auto stand outside[cite: 1].
stepsHi: Platform 1 se ground booking hall mein aayein. Bahar auto stand ke sath Sector 29 mein exit karein.

VASHI.name: Vashi Railway Station
VASHI.police: Prominent GRP Police Station on ground floor near administrative wing[cite: 1]. RPF outpost active near main concourse[cite: 1].
VASHI.policeHi: Administrative wing ke paas ground floor par prominent GRP Police Station hai. Main concourse ke paas RPF outpost active hai.
VASHI.medical: Noble Plus Pharmacy and Wellness Forever (24/7 service outside station plaza)[cite: 1].
VASHI.medicalHi: Noble Plus Pharmacy aur Wellness Forever (station plaza ke bahar 24/7 service).

Platform 1 & 2 (Trans-Harbour).title: Main Concourse & Sector 30 Exit
steps: Use central FOBs or escalators to reach upper concourse deck[cite: 1].
Follow signs for West Exit toward Inorbit Mall road and auto queue[cite: 1].
stepsHi: Upper concourse deck par pahunchne ke liye central FOBs ya escalators use karein.
Inorbit Mall road aur auto queue ki taraf West Exit ke signs follow karein.

Platform 3 & 4 (Up Harbour to CSMT).title: Exiting to International Infotech Park
steps: Walk off upper concourse deck directly into connected commercial complex towers 1 & 2[cite: 1].
stepsHi: Upper concourse deck se seedhe connected commercial complex towers 1 & 2 ke andar utrein.

CBD_BELAPUR.name: CBD Belapur Railway Station
CBD_BELAPUR.police: Dedicated GRP and RPF Outpost on ground floor near Station Master Office[cite: 1].
CBD_BELAPUR.policeHi: Station Master Office ke paas ground floor par dedicated GRP aur RPF Outpost hai.
CBD_BELAPUR.medical: Apollo Pharmacy 3 minutes walk near Sakal Bhavan road junction[cite: 1].
CBD_BELAPUR.medicalHi: Sakal Bhavan road junction ke paas 3 minute ki walk par Apollo Pharmacy hai.

Platform 1 & 2.title: Main Concourse & Auto Stand
steps: Primary UTS booking hall at center of ground floor[cite: 1]. Exit toward commercial sector[cite: 1].
stepsHi: Ground floor ke center mein primary UTS booking hall hai. Commercial sector ki taraf exit karein.

PANVEL.name: Panvel Junction Railway Station
PANVEL.police: Full-scale GRP Station and RPF Thana on Platform 1 ground floor[cite: 1]. EMR operational near station master office[cite: 1].
PANVEL.policeHi: Platform 1 ground floor par full-scale GRP Station aur RPF Thana hai. Station master office ke paas EMR operational hai.
PANVEL.medical: Wellness Forever across West Exit station parking zone[cite: 1].
PANVEL.medicalHi: West Exit station parking zone ke samne Wellness Forever hai.

Platform 1, 2 & 3 (Suburban Local Side).title: Exits: New Panvel vs Old Panvel
Platform 1, 2 & 3 (Suburban Local Side).titleHi: Exits: New Panvel ya Old Panvel
steps: East Exit: Auto stand for New Panvel sectors and colleges[cite: 1].
West Exit: 5-7 min walk to ST Bus Depot[cite: 1].
stepsHi: East Exit: New Panvel sectors aur colleges ke liye auto stand.
West Exit: ST Bus Depot ke liye 5-7 minute ki walk.

KHARGHAR.name: Kharghar Railway Station
KHARGHAR.police: Railway Police Help Desk adjacent to main booking office on West Side[cite: 1].
KHARGHAR.policeHi: West Side par main booking office ke paas Railway Police Help Desk hai.
KHARGHAR.medical: Apollo Pharmacy within 2-minute walk outside West Exit towards Sector 3[cite: 1].
KHARGHAR.medicalHi: West Exit ke bahar Sector 3 ki taraf 2 minute ki walk par Apollo Pharmacy hai.

Platform 1 (West Side - Main Entrance).title: Exiting & Transport (Sector 3 / Highway)
steps: Main UTS Booking Office inside concourse[cite: 1]. Auto stand outside for Hiranandani & colleges[cite: 1].
stepsHi: Concourse ke andar Main UTS Booking Office hai. Hiranandani aur colleges ke liye bahar auto stand hai.
